name: Mt. Davidson
notes: In Mt. Davidson Park. Mount Davidson Cross is at the top. 270 degree views close by at Mount Davidson Vista Point.

name: Noe Peak
notes: South Twin Peak. 360 degree views.

name: Potrero Hill
notes: Residential.

name: Bernal Hill
notes: In Bernal Heights Park. Telecommunications tower equipment on top but can get 360 degree views by walking around it.

name: Stony Hill (Hunters Point Ridge)
notes: Next to a preschool. Residential. Better views at Hilltop Park close by (which also has a large sundial).

name: Telegraph Hill
notes: In Pioneer Park. Views partially obstructed by trees on all sides. For good views ascend Coit Tower for a fee.

name: Strawberry Hill
notes: An island inside Blue Heron Lake in Golden Gate Park. Partially obstructed views.

name: Nob Hill
notes: Hilltop is on the pedestrian-only Priest Street. No view as it is obstructed by buildings.

name: Mount St. Joseph
notes: Residential. Small public area nearby between 290 and 300 Bayview Circle with 90 degree views.

name: Lafayette Heights
notes: In Lafayette Park. Mostly unobstructed views if you walk past the trees on the top.

name: Gold Mine Hill
notes: Residential. Some partially obstructed views.

name: Presidio Hill
notes: Inside the Presidio of San Francisco. Inaccessible due to a municipal water storage basin and WVY transmitter station on the summit. Nearest public access is from the Presidio Golf Course with decent southward views; nearest free access is along the Bay Area Ridge Trail.

name: Buena Vista Heights
notes: In Buena Vista Park. View almost completely obstructed by trees.

name: Corona Heights
notes: In Corona Heights Park. 360 degree views.

name: Castro Hill
notes: Residential.

name: Cannon Hill
notes: Residential. Just outside the Presidio of San Francisco.

name: Rob Hill
notes: Just outside Rob Hill Campground in the Presidio of San Francisco. Obstructed views. Summit under construction as of April 2026.

name: Russian Hill
notes: Right above Ina Coolbrith Park. 180 degree views.

name: Rincon Hill
notes: Urban. Located at the entrance of the One Rincon Hill condominium complex. Next to Interstate 80.

name: Mount Olympus
notes: In the very small Mount Olympus Park. Pedestal of the former Triumph of Light statue on top. Some views but mostly surrounded by houses.

name: Eureka Peak
notes: North Twin Peak. 360 degree views.

name: Dolores Heights
notes: Residential.

name: Grand View Hill
notes: In Grandview Park. 360 degree views with a few trees on top.

name: Red Rock Hill
notes: Inside the Diamond Heights Village Association. No view.

name: Fairmount Heights
notes: Residential. 180 degree views.

name: Holly Hill
notes: Flat top but can get views from all directions by walking around it.

name: Alamo Heights (Hayes Hill)
notes: Near Alamo Square and the Painted Ladies.

name: Macaroon Hill
notes: Residential.

name: Martha Hill
notes: In Dorothy W. Erskine Park. 180 degree views.

name: Horner's Hill
notes: Residential.

name: Monterey Heights
notes: Residential.

name: George Sterling Park
notes: By Lombard Street. Residential.

name: Seal Rocks
notes: An island. Inaccessible but can be viewed from Sutro Baths.

name: Billy Goat Hill
notes: In Billy Goat Hill. 180 degree views.

name: Tank Hill
notes: In Tank Hill Park. 270 degree views.

name: Alta Plaza Park
notes: In Alta Plaza Park. Southward views; northward views obstructed by buildings.

name: Duncan Hill
notes: In Duncan & Castro Open Space. 180 degree views.
